description: Shows the available plans with what each includes, plus the caller's current tier and any allowance used. For when the user asks what a tier costs or has reached a limit. Read-only: it displays pricing and cannot start, change or cancel a subscription. Plans change depth, never truth: the registration verdict, its rdap_source and a domain's price are identical on every tier, and the response lists exactly what does not vary.
name: show_plans
